deck.name: Impeccable 4.0: Design with Range, Taste, and Control

waivers.IMAGE_LOW_DPI: The supplied 640x360 video is the highest-fidelity authentic evidence. PowerPoint render inspection confirms the large screens remain readable; upscaling would not add information.
waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Only proof labels, folios, source footers, and compact sequence labels fall below the 14pt body threshold. Primary titles, context, and decisions are 14pt or larger and were inspected at 1920x1080.
waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: Muted proof metadata is intentionally secondary. Primary content meets the visual hierarchy requirement and the real PowerPoint render confirms readability.
